description: This file defines an interface `EnforcerActorFactory` which specifies a method to create and start an `EnforcerActor` within an Akka actor-based system. It includes method documentation and references to external libraries such as Akka actors and project-specific classes.

classes.name: EnforcerActorFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating sharded `EnforcerActor` instances, parameterized by `ConciergeConfig`.

methods.name: startEnforcerActor
methods.description: Creates and starts an `EnforcerActor` shard region, returning the `ActorRef`. It takes the actor context, configuration, pub-sub mediator, and shard regions as parameters.
